node.title: prop:qfloor: quotient floor exact above norm threshold
node.statement: For a prime-field row C=RS[F_p,D,k] with p congruent to 1 modulo n, quotient order N' dividing n, ell'=rho N'+1, and p>(2ell')^(N'/2), the canonical quotient line at radius 1-rho-1/N' has exactly Acl(N',ell') distinct quotient-value slopes. No below-threshold or extension-field conclusion is asserted.
